body:
§U item 3 shipped as 5a1fde4e — provenance & audit symmetry (rows B + G) plus the meter's outcome-truth UI half (F5).

Landed:
- Retry-attempt ledger: dispatch_with_retry records every failed attempt ({attempt, error, waited_ms}); it rides the ToolResult AND a caller-owned list (survives the None result of an exhausted budget). The tool_call record carries retry_count + attempts end to end (loop emits -> chat.py bridge -> SSE -> frontend ToolCall); a batched tool keeps its ledger too (its AgentStep no longer hardcodes retry_count=0).
- Typed injected-items ledger: _build_environment_context records every injected item with its EXACT rendered text and producer via items_out — record and prompt are built from the same variables, so they cannot drift (render-parity + verbatim-fragment tests pin it). The loop emits one context_injected obs event per surface (loop_turn / init_classify / plan_stream); memory, intent history, workspace state, todo state, goal route and task state ride the same ledger; the compact classify surface records its deliberate narrowness (no stated identity, no tool catalog) as an auditable fact.
- Persistence: the ledger is a new messages column (same defensive-ALTER pattern as the run tree), written at all three persist sites, served by the history endpoint, restored on reload.
- Degraded phase: agent_loop_degraded persists in build_agent_phases (terminal -> "Provider died — evidence delivered as gathered"; partial -> "Provider interrupted — partial evidence delivered"; provider + code in the detail) and maps to a frontend phase row.
- Outcome truth (F5): a reply carrying the canonical error renders the turn FAILED even when every tool row succeeded; the fold-up names "didn't finish"; the plan pill reads "1/3 plan · didn't finish" on a dead run instead of bare progress; tool steps show "N retries" and expand into the attempt ledger; the context popover gains "Injected this turn" — every item, exact text, producer, unknown kinds rendered opaque, never hidden.

Verification (all live, this sandbox):
- Full backend suite 3720 passed / 2 skipped (+13 new: tests/core/test_provenance_ledger.py); two pre-existing fakes updated for the grown dispatch contract (signature + passive-audit allowlist on the direct/clarify tripwire — the event records the classify prompt, it boots nothing).
- Frontend vitest 640 passed / 61 files (+15 new across turnTimeline / TurnView / agentPhases / CenterPanel), tsc clean.
- NEW scripts/live_test_provenance_symmetry.py PASS on an own run: probe A — every recorded item's text appears verbatim in the captured provider prompt (record == wire), stated identity rides the record as a typed item; probe B — code_exec double-timeout (2s dispatch budget) leaves retry_count=1 with BOTH attempts ("timed out after 2s") on the failed tool_call event; probe C — sysinfo evidence then the 12:45 insufficient-balance death: agent_loop_degraded {terminal, payment_required, provider named} on the wire + canonical error object + honest answer; reload — GET history returns 12 persisted items AND the degraded phase with the code in its detail.
- Regression: live_test_provider_death_honesty.py and live_test_identity_injection.py both PASS on own runs (the touched paths keep the item 1-2 guarantees).
